init.title: Xi'an Water Options
init.description: Calibration corrects the estimates: enter the **actual balance** on a given date (from the water utility app / meter). The integration back-calculates the real daily consumption since the last recharge and re-derives the daily estimated cost, remaining days, daily average and cumulative usage. Leave empty to disable calibration.

data.calibration_amount: Calibration amount (actual balance on that date, CNY)
